groups.subject: size the closing block to the terminal it lands on
groups.body: The closing block measured its own width and ignored the terminal it was printed into, so a narrow window wrapped it mid-sentence. It now reads the terminal's columns and sizes itself to what it lands on.

groups.subject: seed the three placeholder tools
groups.body: The registry had nothing to list, so no case could read a listing back. Three placeholder files give it one, and the changelog records that they arrived.
